Sources. Negative-price statistics computed from AEMO aggregated price & demand data (5-minute RRP, Jan 2019 – Jul 2026, all five NEM regions; 2019–Sep 2021 = 30-min trading intervals). Scenario days replay the real 5-minute RRP, averaged to 30-minute steps for the dispatch desk (the NEM settles on 5-minute dispatch). Mining verdict: gross energy margin Σ(compute value − price) over all intervals at or below the value, trailing 12 months. Battery buildout & revenue: Modo Energy BESS indices (Aug 2026). Renewables share, price levels, SA minimum demand & battery price-setting: AEMO Quarterly Energy Dynamics Q2 2026 (via pv-tech.org). Solar capture & LGC context: Modo Energy research (May 2026). Geography & asset placement stylised; capacities indicative.

About this atlas

The one-line thesis: Australia's NEM now spends so many hours below $0/MWh — 30% of all of 2025 in South Australia — that a flexible compute load can treat the grid like a tide: run when the solar flood is in, idle when it's out.

The decision. Unlike a peaker's compute-or-export arbitrage, a grid-connected campus has one lever: compute, or don't. The NEM dispatches every five minutes; for readability the desk replays days in 30-minute steps. Each step the sim compares the regional spot price to your compute value (default $110/MWh, a stylised mining break-even). At or below it, the campus runs — sometimes literally paid to consume. Above it, racks idle and the workload waits for the next flood.

The scene. The five NEM regions are real; the day/night cycle, prices and decisions replay four real days from AEMO data. Teal cores and rings mark computing campuses; pulses on the interconnectors flow from cheap regions to expensive ones. Tasmania's hydro barely ever goes negative — watch Basslink.

What this isn't. Not investment advice, not a siting study. Capacities are indicative, geography is stylised, and a real campus would care about network charges, MLFs, curtailment risk and contracts — none of which are modelled here.

Built with Blender-authored geometry, three.js, and AEMO/Modo Energy data · RenewaBlox · August 2026

The model: a 100 MW compute campus in each region runs whenever the spot price ≤ your compute value — below $0 it is paid to run. The NEM dispatches every 5 minutes; the desk steps in 30-min averages for readability. Real AEMO days · native 5-min RRP · © RenewaBlox
